decisions.statement: Use file-based JSON interchange as the primary portable cross-AI mechanism; never infer API access from a share URL.
Capability declarations must be evidence-backed and tool-specific; dedicated web browsing is distinct from arbitrary network access in code execution.
Consolidate repositories through inventory, source comparison, explicit canonical boundaries, reversible pull requests, and preserved history; do not mass-merge by name or README similarity.
